name: checkout payment storm with secondary redis noise
purpose: Demonstrate storm mode with branch-specific skill selection, conflict resolution, extra evidence collection, and final common-root convergence.

alert_event.symptom: HTTP 504 spike, payment success rate drop from 99.2% to 71.4%, order latency p95 increased to 4.8s

branches.name: checkout-service transaction creation timeout
branches.initial_signal: checkout-service span duration 3.9s to 5.2s, HTTP 504 propagated to entry API
branches.branch_hypothesis: checkout-service cannot acquire DB connection before payment orchestration

branches.name: payment-service upstream timeout
branches.initial_signal: payment-service reports client timeout and cancelled payment request
branches.branch_hypothesis: payment provider outage or caller-side cancellation

branches.name: inventory redis hot key latency
branches.initial_signal: inventory-service has Redis GET/DECR latency spikes on flash-sale SKU
branches.branch_hypothesis: Redis hot key contributes to partial latency but is not shared by all failed traces

branches.name: order-service mysql slow insert
branches.initial_signal: order-service insert_order waits behind checkout transaction
branches.branch_hypothesis: MySQL lock wait is downstream consequence of checkout transaction pressure

branches.name: recommendation-service canary restart noise
branches.initial_signal: recommendation-service pod restarted during the same time window
branches.branch_hypothesis: Unrelated noisy event sharing the alert window

rounds.goal: 将单个告警扩展为多条 Error Trace，并按调用路径、异常形态、实体关系生成诊断分支。

branch_actions.reason: A 分支 Trace 完整且 checkout-service 是最长错误 span。
evidence_delta: 5 条 Trace 在 checkout-service 出现 ERROR 或 timeout
checkout-service 到 mysql-checkout 的连接获取 span 出现 timeout
入口 504 与 checkout-service 超时高度同步

branch_actions.reason: B 分支需要确认 payment-service 是根因还是被上游取消。
evidence_delta: payment-service span 出现 cancelled by caller
third-party-pay 无全局错误率升高

branch_actions.reason: C 分支 Trace 中 Redis 调用缺少完整服务标签，需要先绑定实体。
evidence_delta: redis-inventory 绑定到 inventory-service
热点 SKU sku-8848 出现在 2 条异常 Trace

branch_actions.reason: D 分支涉及 order-service 与 mysql-order，需要先确认下游关系。
evidence_delta: order-service 位于 checkout-service 下游
MySQL slow insert 发生在 checkout-service 超时之后

branch_actions.reason: E 分支可能是时间窗口噪声，先确认是否属于告警主链路。
evidence_delta: recommendation-service 不在 checkout 强依赖路径
重启事件无入口错误率同步上升

rounds.round_summary: 已生成 5 个分支。A 分支最接近共同根因；B/D 可能是传播影响；C 是局部次要问题候选；E 暂时标记为噪声。下一轮并行取证，不要求所有分支调用相同 Skill。

rounds.goal: 每个分支根据当前缺失证据选择最合适的 Skill，补齐 Trace、Log、Metric 或 Graph 证据。

branch_actions.reason: A 已有 Trace 证据，需要确认 checkout-service 是否存在资源或连接池瓶颈。
evidence_delta: db.pool.active.connections 100%
db.pool.pending.acquire p95 2800ms
CPU 62%、memory 71%，未达到资源饱和阈值

branch_actions.reason: B 需要从日志确认 payment-service 是主动失败还是收到取消请求。
evidence_delta: payment-service log: request cancelled by upstream checkout timeout
未发现 PaymentProviderUnavailableException

branch_actions.reason: C 需要验证 Redis hot key 是否形成系统性瓶颈。
evidence_delta: redis-inventory p99 latency 95ms
hotkey sku-8848 qps 异常升高
只覆盖 1/5 条 Error Trace

branch_actions.reason: D 需要确认 MySQL slow insert 的具体等待原因。
evidence_delta: order-service log: lock wait timeout after checkout transaction hold
slow insert 时间晚于 checkout-service pool pending

branch_actions.reason: E 已疑似噪声，只需确认它对 checkout 主链路是否有影响。
evidence_delta: recommendation-service 只影响推荐位降级
不影响 /checkout/pay 主流程

rounds.round_summary: A 分支新增强指标证据，支持 checkout-service 连接池耗尽。B/D 更像 A 的传播影响。C 是真实局部问题但覆盖面不足。E 可排除。

rounds.goal: 解决 Redis hot key、payment timeout、MySQL slow insert 与 checkout 连接池耗尽之间的主次关系。

branch_actions.reason: A 需要日志异常栈确认连接池耗尽是否发生在最早错误点。
evidence_delta: checkout-service log: DbConnectionAcquireTimeoutException
first_error_time=10:16:58，早于 B/C/D 分支显性错误

branch_actions.reason: B 需要排除 payment provider 自身故障。
evidence_delta: payment-service CPU、线程池、provider_error_rate 正常
payment timeout 与 checkout caller timeout 同步

branch_actions.reason: C 需要确认 Redis hot key 是否存在于共同失败路径。
evidence_delta: Redis hot key 只出现在库存预占路径
4 条失败 Trace 未调用 redis-inventory

branch_actions.reason: D 需要确认 mysql-order 是源头瓶颈还是被上游事务拖慢。
evidence_delta: mysql-order max_connections 63%
lock_wait_count 升高发生在 checkout pool pending 之后

rounds.round_summary: 冲突已基本消解：Redis 是局部次要问题，payment timeout 与 MySQL slow insert 是传播影响，checkout-service DB 连接池耗尽是最早且覆盖面最大的共同根因。

rounds.goal: 合并多分支证据，形成共同根因、分支差异、影响面与置信度。

branch_actions.reason: A 分支已具备 Trace、Metric、Log 三类强证据。
evidence_delta: root_cause_candidate=checkout-service db_connection_pool_exhaustion
confidence=0.91

branch_actions.reason: B 已排除独立根因，转为影响面分析。
evidence_delta: payment success rate drop 是 checkout timeout 的业务影响
未发现支付供应商全局故障

branch_actions.reason: C 存在真实异常但覆盖面不足，需要判断是否为第二根因。
evidence_delta: secondary_candidate=redis hot key
confidence=0.48
requires_extra_boundary_check=true

branch_actions.reason: D 转为下游影响面确认。
evidence_delta: order creation degradation follows checkout transaction pressure
not_common_root=true

rounds.round_summary: 共同根因已收敛到 checkout-service DB 连接池耗尽，置信度 0.91。但 C 分支存在 Redis hot key 局部异常，需要追加一轮补证据，明确它是次要问题还是并发第二根因。

rounds.intent: 追加补证据：次要根因边界确认
rounds.goal: 验证 Redis hot key 是否需要作为并发第二根因进入最终报告。

branch_actions.reason: C 分支需要与全量 5 条 Error Trace 做覆盖率和时间线一致性检查。
evidence_delta: Redis hot key 覆盖 1/5 条 Error Trace
Redis p99 升高开始于 10:18:12，晚于 checkout pool 耗尽 74 秒
Redis 异常可解释库存预占慢，但不能解释 payment timeout 与 order lock wait

branch_actions.reason: A 分支作为共同根因候选，需要验证覆盖率。
evidence_delta: checkout DB pool pending 覆盖 4/5 条 Error Trace
mysql-checkout 依赖节点在 checkout-service 下游，连接获取失败早于业务下游调用
first_error_time 最早
可解释 payment、order、entry 504 三类症状

rounds.round_summary: 追加补证据后，Redis hot key 被降级为局部次要问题；checkout-service DB 连接池耗尽保留为共同根因。最终报告需要同时给出主根因和次要风险。

common_root_cause.message: checkout-service DB connection pool was exhausted before payment orchestration and order creation.

excluded_candidates.reason: Timeouts were caused by upstream cancellation; payment provider metrics were normal.
Lock waits occurred after checkout transaction pressure and did not start first.
Canary restart was outside the checkout critical path.

business_impact: Flash-sale checkout success rate dropped to 71.4%.
Payment requests were cancelled before provider confirmation.
Some order creation requests entered retry or pending state.
Inventory reservation for hot SKU sku-8848 showed partial latency amplification.
recommended_actions: Immediately raise checkout-service DB pool limit only if database capacity allows it.
Reduce checkout transaction hold time and add timeout isolation before payment orchestration.
Add pool pending acquire alert and caller-cancelled payment alert correlation.
Mitigate redis-inventory hot key with local cache or sharded reservation counter.
Keep recommendation-service restart out of P1 root cause but record it as noise in the incident timeline.

presentation_notes: This case should show that storm mode does not force every branch through the same fixed Skill path.
The key review moment is round 5: the system dynamically adds a boundary-check round instead of prematurely declaring two root causes.
The topology view should mark checkout-service as the common root, redis-inventory as a secondary local issue, and payment/order as impacted downstream nodes.
